Cream center, peach edge depth and restrained white highlights reproduce the fixed target with a smooth controlled outer rim. Side-by-side original comparison shows more integrated rim/light modeling and cleaner warm finish. It coheres with the approved native heart/smile family while retaining its broad quiet preference role and excluding their emotion marks.

Inspected raw canonical artwork on light/gray/dark, all108 frames in enlarged and logical sheets, and representative/boundary frames for all recipes over all3 backgrounds. No visible external halo/haze, opaque matte, detached debris, dead black patches, edge clipping or inappropriate shimmer. The canonical source exactly equals one authorized alpha>8 bounds rectangle from raw target; retained RGBA/alpha unchanged.

Original complete frame/root/sourceScale, original six-by-two atlas layout, all9 clips/12 frames/12fps, order, idle-only runtime loop flags, bob, appear scaling/opacity and fade endpoints are unchanged. All432 logical slots resolve to108 actual S frames and9 atlases through exact camera-facing aliases. Current -172 attachment and separate native timer keep the balloon above the seated customer in actual Godot unposed/posed captures. Historical -90 example is explicitly historical; eel is honestly catalog-only.
